name: OBS Studio 33.0.1
body:
33.0.1 Hotfix Changes
---------------------

* Fixed a crash on startup when logged into a service integration [WizardCM] ([#554](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/pull/554))
* Fixed a crash when logging into the Twitch integration [WizardCM] ([#14072](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14072))
* Fixed a deadlock when logging into the YouTube integration [WizardCM] ([#556](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/pull/556))
* Fixed a race condition where browser panels could end up with incorrectly sized content [WizardCM] ([#558](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-browser/pull/558))
* Fixed a memory leak when using the image slideshow source [prgmitchell] ([#14078](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14078))
* Fixed plugins failing to load on Flatpak [FiniteSingularity] ([#14103](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14103))
* Fixed Plugin Manager not prompting for save after a change until the dialog is re-opened [Warchamp7] ([#14112](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14112))

33.0 New Features
-----------------

* Updated CEF from 127/6533 to 150/7871 [WizardCM] ([#13900](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13900))
  + This is a massive update to the underlying framework used for browser sources and docks from the July 2024 release to September 2026
  + All of this work is on the backend and should be invisible to users. Please be sure to report any new weirdness or problems you run into with browser sources!
* Complete overhaul to plugin loading [FiniteSingularity/PatTheMav] ([#13594](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13594))
  + First-party plugins are now in a new folder named core
  + Third-party plugins have an updated installation location and folder structure
  + Existing third-party plugins will continue to load from the legacy locations until OBS Studio 34.0
  + More information is available in our [knowledge base article](https://obsproject.com/kb/legacy-plugin-locations)
* Improved how source snapping works in the preview [Warchamp7] ([#12298](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12298))
  + New visual indicator added
  + Sources now snap along the entire axis instead of only when directly touching
  + Sources no longer snap to hidden sources
* Improved behavior of spinboxes for number values [Warchamp7] ([#12337](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12337))
  + Typing is no longer mysteriously blocked in some situations
  + Numbers are no longer cut off in some situations
  + Values now update only after pressing Enter and Enter does not close the window
  + Holding Shift + Up/Down now advances multiple steps at a time
  + Dragging the cursor inside the input but outside the text itself now works properly
* Enabled NVENC on Arm64 [RytoEX] ([#13827](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13827))

33.0 Changes
------------

* Added a check for encoders being missing when loading a profile [derrod] ([#11340](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/11340))
* Added support for newest NVIDIA Broadcast SDKs for NVIDIA Audio Effects and Video Effects [pkviet] ([#13838](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13838))
* Added hotkeys for controlling audio monitoring of a source [Warchamp7] ([#13599](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13599))
* Changed Safe Mode to not start WebSocket Server [FiniteSingularity/RytoEX] ([#13984](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13984))
* Fixed issues with groups in Studio Mode [Warchamp7] ([#11092](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/11092))
  + Fixed moving sources inside a group causing them to glitch out in Program
  + Fixed moving sources inside a group showing up live in Program
* Adjusted naming of Window Capture methods on Windows [Penwy] ([#12047](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12047))
* Improved detection of fullscreen games for Game Capture [Kira-NT] ([#10880](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/10880))
* Improved transparency handling for macOS Screen Capture [jcm93] ([#13030](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13030))
* Scaled simple output recording audio bitrate by channel count [nickvonkaenel] ([#13311](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13311))
* Removed support for Ubuntu 24.04 

33.0 Bug Fixes
--------------

* Added a startup error if obs-transitions failed to load [notr1ch] ([#13321](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13321))
* Improved file splitting for Hybrid MP4/MOV [derrod] ([#13386](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13386))
* Fixed outputs getting stuck running when a bad rescale output resolution is set [suogesi] ([#13375](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13375))
* Fixed monitoring icon state getting desynced when using third-party tools or websockets [prgmitchell] ([#13822](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13822))
* Fixed a crash on macOS 27.2 when starting OBS Studio [RytoEX] ([#14070](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/14070))
* Fixed potential crash when shader cache file is invalid [notr1ch] ([#13538](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13538))
* Fixed a potential crash on Linux when USB mic is removed [R0te/RytoEX] ([#13922](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13922))
* Fixed a potential crash when renaming a source with the Add Source window open [Warchamp7] ([#13800](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13800))
* Fixed a potential deadlock during video/audio tasks [exeldro] ([#13579](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13579))
* Fixed an issue with B-frame offset calculation in AMF that could cause streams to disconnect [lexano-ivs] ([#13762](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13762))
* Fixed PipeWire screencast sources being duplicated in studio mode [tytan652] ([#13673](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13673))
* Fixed a potential crash when switching off a newly created profile [Warchamp7] ([#13182](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13182))
* Fixed a source toolbar crash when source type is missing [Penwy] ([#13539](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13539))
* Fixed profile import failing on paths with a trailing slash [Ushkalovk] ([#13863](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13863))

33.0 Developer Information
--------------------------

* Added frontend event and output signal for replay buffer saving [Penwy] ([#8955](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/8955))
* Added guidance regarding the theme system to the top of all theme files [Warchamp7] ([#13733](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13733))
* Added ability to set a file extension filter for OBS_PATH_FILE_SAVE path types [FiniteSingularity] ([#10190](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/10190))
* Added obs_frontend_is_safe_mode for first-party plugins
  + Third-party plugins are not loaded at all in Safe Mode
* Added versions to Flatpak plugin extension point [tytan652] ([#13735](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13735))
* Added obs_canvas_video_active() to check if the video of a canvas is active [exeldro] ([#13110](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13110))
* The minimum supported versions of Visual Studio, Windows SDK, and clang-format have been increased. Previous versions may continue to work, but will no longer be tested/supported. It is recommended that build environments are kept up-to-date with the project's toolchain.
  + Changed Windows builds to use Visual Studio 2026 and SDK 26100 [RytoEX] ([#13543](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13543))
  + Changed clang-format version used to 22.1.3 [PatTheMav] ([#13549](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13549))
* Changed obs_canvas_reset_video() to allow resetting a canvas's video when any other canvas's video is active, but not its own video [exeldro] ([#13110](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13110))
* Updated libnsgif to 1.0.0 [RytoEX] ([#11178](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/11178))
  + This is a breaking change for any plugins using libobs/graphics gs_image_file
* Clarified documentation for obs_module_unload [notr1ch] ([#13327](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13327))
* Required MbedTLS 3 and exclude 4 or later [tytan652] ([#13799](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13799))
* Removed support for FFmpeg 6.x and 7.x [RytoEX] ([#13964](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13964))
* Removed support for Qt 6.4-6.9 [RytoEX] ([#13969](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13969))
* Fixed repeated preview enable/disables not working [WarmUpTill] ([#12580](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/12580))
* Only emit core signal handlers for public canvases [tt2468] ([#13574](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13574))
* Deprecated unused hidden API for sources [derrod] ([#13122](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13122))
* Deprecated APIs for audio source monitoring_type [Warchamp7] ([#13599](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/13599))
  + This is replaced by a new monitoring_enabled boolean
